name: kimi-code

command.argv_notes: Evidence: kimi-job-runner/src/kimi-process.ts buildKimiArgs (lines 160-181): print mode is `-p <prompt> --output-format stream-json`; model is `-m`; extra dirs are `--add-dir`. `-p` fixes auto permission and is mutually exclusive with --yolo/--auto/--plan (startup refusal), so no permission flag is ever passed here.

env._env_notes: native_default = paidan does not set the variable at all (kimi runs against the user's real home). Paidan never stages or copies kimi config.

permission.presets_notes: print mode fixes auto permission; kimi has NO native headless read-only tier (probe run 5f0d9fc2: task-mode=read-only wrote the file anyway). read-only stays unsupported until the ACP transport lane exists.

denial_evidence.via: parser detects the Moonshot provider safety-block terminal line on stderr (format evidenced by kimi-job-runner/src/kimi-output.ts:60); not yet live-probed through paidan

resume.notes: Evidence: kimi-job-runner/src/kimi-process.ts:169 passes `-S <sessionId>`; the native stderr hint prints `kimi -r session_xxx` (kimi-output.ts:56, whole-line only). sessionId is extracted from the stdout meta row {role:"meta", type:"session.resume_hint", session_id} (kimi-output.ts:102-111). kimi's native session store is scoped per working directory (sessions/wd_<hash>/): a resume run must use the same cwd as the original run, else the endpoint exits non-zero (paidan probe P3, 2026-09-10). Model inheritance on resume: officially unspecified.

models.notes: v0: heuristic scan of the user's native kimi config.toml for connection/model aliases (managed:kimi-code oauth + kimi-for-coding inline-key are two separate connections). Selection = config.json defaults; no cross-connection fallback.

effort.notes: Thinking-effort selection has NO CLI flag in 0.42.0 (--effort dies at arg parsing); the env var is the only config-file-free delivery channel. KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT forces thinking.effort and overrides the native config.toml [thinking] effort key (kimi's effort lives in the [thinking] section, not at the top level; readNativeDefaults reads the same section); precedence -m > env > config (official env-vars/overrides docs). Verified 2026-09-11: effort=max PONG via env, effort=bogus -> provider 400 (the value provably reaches the API). options = the k3 line support_efforts (low/high/max) read from the native config; medium/xhigh exist in the official level set but k3 does not declare them and stay out. The native config.toml already carries effort = max, so leaving paidan effort unset inherits max from the native home.

parser_notes: stream-json JSONL on stdout: assistant text rows {role:"assistant", content}; session hint {role:"meta", type:"session.resume_hint", session_id, command}. Non-JSON stdout line or mid-line EOF degrades the parser (terminal judgment then cannot be exit-code-based). Evidence: kimi-job-runner/src/kimi-output.ts:88-114.
